Frequently asked questions

Expand all

Yes, businesses who bundle AT&T Business Fiber with AT&T Phone for Business and order online can qualify for a reward card offer.

While the best service will always depend on individual needs, preferences, and availability, there are many good reasons to choose an AT&T Business Fiber and AT&T Phone for Business bundle. AT&T Business Fiber provides over 99% reliability¹, AT&T Active ArmorSM², unlimited internet data, and more. AT&T Phone for Business provides unlimited calling in the U.S., plus calls to Mexico and Canada, 20+ traditional calling features, voice-to-text notifications and transcription, and bundle pricing with no contracts or equipment required.

¹ Based on network availability.
² Available only with Business Fiber plans (300M-500M) and requires Smart Home Manager App: Security features must be enabled.

AT&T Business Fiber provides plans that are fast, reliable and cost effective for your business. Also, plans from AT&T Business Fiber provide symmetrical internet speeds. This means that they provide close to equal upload and download speeds.

While the best phone service will of course depend on your individual team’s needs and preferences, there are plenty of great reasons to choose AT&T Phone for Business. AT&T Phone for Business includes unlimited calling in the U.S., plus calls to Mexico, Canada, and U.S. Territories, more than 20 traditional calling features, and advanced features like Voice-to-Text Transcription.

AT&T Phone for Business includes more than 25 features to help you effectively manage your inbound and outbound calls. Traditional features include Caller ID, Call Waiting, Call Forwarding, and Three-way Calling. Advanced features include Locate Me, Flexible Caller ID, and Voicemail-to-Text Transcription.* 

*Caller ID may not always be available for all calls.

AT&T Phone for Business works with most existing analog phones, including analog Key Telephone Systems (KTS). This means that you may not need new phone equipment to use the service.

We offer an integrated 5G internet backup at no extra cost for our 1 GIG or higher business fiber plans and offer AT&T Managed 5G Internet Backup as an add-on service for our 300Mbps and 500Mbps plans. This protects your business and keeps mission-critical devices up and running in the unlikely event of a power or service outage. 

Coverage not available everywhere. Learn more at att.com/5Gnetwork. Ltd availability/areas. Req’s Business Fiber 1 GIG or higher & WNC-CGW452 gateway. Wireless 5G backup does not work in the event of a loss of power. LTE coverage may be used depending on signal availability. Go to att.com/wirelesscoverage for details. Other terms apply

AT&T Phone for Business is a voice service provided over an Internet Protocol (VoIP) digital connection that transmits calls over a highly secure IP network using either AT&T Internet for Business or AT&T Business Fiber.
